sentences.text: 3. Injured claimant met with an accident on 23.05.2020 and filed claim petition claiming compensation.
The Tribunal considering the entire evidence on record, dismissed the application.

Aggrieved by the said order, he preferred an appeal and today requested before this court to remand the NC: 2026:KHC:6917 HC-KAR matter for adducing the evidence and also to examine author of Ex.P11 to prove the involvement of the vehicle.

4. This court finds it reasonable to remand the matter, with a specific direction to the Tribunal to grant reasonable opportunity to both sides for adducing evidence and for arguments and to dispose of the matter on merits by duly considering the entire evidence on record within two months from the date of this order.
Accordingly, this appeal is disposed of.
Registry is directed to send the records to the Trial Court within 10 days.
